title: Lech Multiplicity Conjecture for Flat Local Extensions
exact_target: Lech's conjecture: if $(R,\mathfrak m)\to(S,\mathfrak n)$ is a flat local extension of Noetherian local rings, then $e(R)\leq e(S)$.
